blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Threats of violence, harassment, or even death can cause fear and distress and may signal the risk of further harm if left unaddressed. Recently, a 41-year-old pharmacist was shot dead along V. Rama Avenue in Barangay Calamba, Cebu City, with her former partner arrested as the suspect. Investigators are examining a possible crime of passion, as the two had previously been in a relationship that had recently ended. Sources close to the victim said the suspect had repeatedly tried to win her back, but she declined to resume their relationship. The suspect allegedly issued threats against her […]...
